fixture_notes.vllm_scheduler.py.txt: Byte-for-byte scheduler snapshot; stored as text to avoid reformatting upstream code.
fixture_notes.workload.json: Anonymous prompt/cache lengths and relative arrivals; no prompt text or tokens.
fixture_notes.observed_batches.json: Derived scheduler submit/result timestamps; result consumption is not device completion.
fixture_notes.scheduler_config.json: Only the scheduling-related subset of the 1K reference configuration.

limitations: Exact schedule/split/accounting functions; initialization and KV/output metadata are doubles
Fixed observed cache hits; no KV capacity pressure, shared-prefix boundary or cache warming
Four-slot synthetic FIFO; lazy push, TPU/MTP execution and real KV transfer are not modeled
Historical intervals are a sensitivity assumption, not a performance prediction
Compile sizes do not enter schedule(); global token budget controls chunk capacity
Batch counts are scheduler submissions, not measured TPU forward or MTP draft counts
